text: Android: local-only area for shopping lists and checklists (B3)

From the B1 review: a stored, translated label for the local area goes stale when the locale changes; keep kind=local and render the label from a string resource at display time. The full-screen update block (every server account outdated) must not hide the local area's lists.

Merged as five cherry-picked commits (HEAD b71ad9a), full gate green. Review: one local account per phone under a mutex; the kind rule enforced in ListsRepo.create/setKind, not only in the dialog; a local list is hard-deleted (never synced); the full-screen update block is off whenever a local area exists; local accounts excluded from invites, sync and the status seed. 19 mutations caught. Chosen differently: 'Leave list' reads 'Delete list' for a local list with its own confirmation.
